attributes.name: testimonial layout
attributes.definition: How the testimonial section is visually arranged on the page.

values.definition: Photo on one side and quote on a contrasting panel on the other.
Any other testimonial arrangement, such as cards, carousel or single column.
Layout is not described or no testimonials are present.

attributes.name: testimonial markup semantics
attributes.definition: Which HTML elements are used to mark up testimonials and related contact information.

values.definition: Uses blockquote, cite and figure for testimonials, and an address element for contact info.
Uses generic div or span elements with no quote-specific semantics.
Markup is not described or no testimonials are present.
